invite.dateUndecided: The date is being decided together

form.childrenQuestion: How many children are coming with you?
form.childrenHint: We only need the number. We never ask for or keep children's names, ages or any other details.
form.textHint: Please don't write details about children here (names, ages).
form.childDetailsBody: About children we keep only how many are coming. Please remove the name, age or birth date from your answer. If this is not about a child, leave the text as it is and continue.
form.emailQuestion: Where can we tell you if something changes?
form.emailHint: Leave an email address only if you want to hear when the date, place or programme changes. We use it for nothing else.
form.emailHintOnFile: We already have an address for you. Leave this empty to keep it, or write another one.
form.reviewIntro: Have a look, then send. You can still change your reply later.

summary.emailKept: We keep the address we have

title.yes: We look forward to seeing you
title.no: We're sorry you can't make it

recorded.saved: We have your reply. Thank you!
recorded.childrenNote: About children we keep only the number.
recorded.closed: The reply deadline has passed. If something changed, please write to the host directly.

closed.title: The reply deadline has passed
closed.body: We can no longer take replies here. If you would still like to come, please write to the host directly.

status.cancelledBody: The host cancelled the event. No reply is needed any more.
status.postponedBody: The host is looking for a new date. Come back to this link to find out.

changes.title: Something changed since your last visit
changes.generic: The host updated the event details. Have a look below.
changes.date: The event date was set or changed.
changes.questions: The host added or changed the questions for guests.
changes.poll: The host proposed new dates. Tell us which ones suit you.

foot.privacy: This link belongs to your household only. We keep just your reply and, about children, only how many are coming.

gone.title: This link is no longer valid.
gone.body: It may have been replaced or it may have expired. Please ask the host for a new link.

throttled.title: Too many attempts
throttled.body: Please try again a little later.

errors.atLeastOneAdult: At least one adult has to come.
errors.childDetails: It looks like you wrote details about a child.
errors.closed: The reply deadline has passed. Please write to the host directly.
errors.lastPlaceTaken: Sorry, the last place was taken just now. Places left: {left}.
errors.linkGone: This link is no longer valid. Please ask the host for a new one.
errors.needTwoOptions: Write at least two options, one per line.

email.subject: You are invited: {title}
email.intro: You are invited to “{title}”. We would be delighted to have you with us.
email.linkNote: The link belongs to your household only. You don't need an account.
email.childrenNote: If you bring children, we only ask how many — no other detail.
